mapper.sql: id, company_id, name, email, phone, resume_url, resume_md, parsed_json, embedding, source, tags_json, created_by, create_time, update_time
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO opc_hr_candidate (id, company_id, name, email, phone, resume_url, resume_md, parsed_json, embedding, source, tags_json, created_by) VALUES (#{id}, #{companyId}, #{name}, #{email}, #{phone}, #{resumeUrl}, #{resumeMd}, #{parsedJson}, #{embedding}, #{source}, #{tagsJson}, #{createdBy})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM opc_hr_candidate WHERE id = #{id} AND company_id = #{companyId}
